The Consent Calendar adopting the printed recommended actions will be enacted with one vote. If Councilmembers or Staff wish to address any item on the Consent Calendar

Approve the Scope of Work for Preparing the Ten Year Electric Distribution System Master Plan and Authorize Staff to Prepare RFP And Solicit Proposals. Recommendation: Approve the Scope of Work for preparation of Azusa Light & Water's Ten Year Electric Distribution System Master Plan and authorize staff to issue Request for Proposals (RFP).

Approve the Purchase of a High Voltage Cable Reel Trailer and Authorize Issuance of Purchase Order to Vermeer of the Pacific Company. Recommendation: Approve the purchase of a cable reel trailer in the amount not-to-exceed $18,208.67, inclusive of applicable sales taxes and delivery charges, and authorize the issuance of a Purchase Order to the dealer, Vermeer of the Pacific Company, located in Fontana, California, pursuant to Azusa Municipal Code Section 2-523(e), Article VII Chapter 2.

Approve a One-Year Contract Extension to SA Associates for Rosedale Inspection Services. Recommendation: Approve a one-year contract extension of the Professional Services Agreement with SA Associates and authorize an amendment to add $10,000 to the existing Purchase Order, with no change in rates.
D-6.1. SA Contract Extension
D-6.2. SA Associates Contract
7.
Adopt Resolution for Grant of Easement for Water Utility Purposes from Property Owner Northrop Grumman Systems Corporation. Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. UB-9-14 for a Grant of Easement for Water Utility purposes located on Northrop Grumman's property at 301 Aerojet Avenue in the City of Azusa; and authorize the City Clerk to file said Easement with the Office of the Los Angeles County Recorder. A RESOLUTION OF THE UTILITY BOARD/CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA ACCEPTING A CERTAIN GRANT OF PERMANENT EASEMENT AND DIRECTING THE RECORDING THEREOF.

Agreement with State of California for Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP). Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. UB-10-14 approving agreement with the State of California for residential Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) to assist qualifying electric customers with their electric bills; and (2) authorize the Mayor to execute attached agreement with the State of California. A RESOLUTION OF THE UTILITY BOARD OF THE CITY OF AZUSA, APPROVING AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA, DEPARTMENT OF COMMUNITY SERVICES AND DEVELOPMENT, FOR LOW INCOME HOME ENERGY ASSISTANCE PROGRAM FOR AZUSA RESIDENTS.

SCHEDULED ITEMS
1.
Public Hearing to Adopt Resolution UB-11-14 Amending The Fiscal Year 2014/15 Water Fund Expense Budget by $2,019,000 to Pay for Supplemental/ Emergency Water Purchase and the Water Fund Revenue Budget by $1,817,000 for the Lease of Related Water Rights. Recommendation: Open the Public Hearing; receive testimony, close the Public Hearing, waive further reading and adopt the attached Resolution UB-11-14 to: 1) amend the Water Fund Expense Budget for Fiscal Year 2014/15 in the amount of $2,019,000 for the purchase of up to 3000 Acre-Feet of supplemental water from Upper San Gabriel Municipal Water District through the Main San Gabriel Basin Watermaster and 2) amend the Water Fund Revenue Budget for FY 14/15 in the amount of $1,817,000 to reflect the revenue projected for the lease of associated water rights. A RESOLUTION OF THE UTILITY BOARD/CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2014-2015 WATER UTILITY OPERATING BUDGET FOR THE PURHCASE OF EMERGENCY/SUPPLEMENTAL WATER AND LEASE OF RELATED WATER RIGHTS.

E-1.2. Reso-Water Purchase Budget Amend

2.
Report and Recommendation Pursuant to California Assembly Bill 2514 on Establishing Energy Storage Targets. Recommendation: Accept the attached Energy Storage Report and adopt Resolution No. UB-12-14 providing that the energy storage targets for Azusa Light & Water for December 31, 2016 and December 31, 2021 are set at zero. A RESOLUTION OF THE UTILITY BOARD/CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA, CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING FINDINGS AND RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING FEASIBILITY AND COST EFFECTIVENESS OF IMPLEMENTING ENERGY STORAGE ON AZUSA OWNED, OPERATED OR CONTROLLED POWER SYSTEM PURSUANT TO REQUIREMENTS OF THE CALIFORNIA ASSEMBLY BILL (AB) 2514.
